Hi new followers!
A bit about me:
I was born in Iran. I spent my childhood living through the Iran-Iraq war—a bloody ordeal that killed ≈1M ppl.
At 7 I was used to going to funerals. 
At 13 I was stitching up wounds in a hospital as a volunteer. 
At 14 I escaped to the U.S. as an unaccompanied minor.
I’ve spent my adult life here sharing joy & building spaces of belonging w/refugees—focusing on children. 
I’ve seen what war does—it lives in me, & I recognize its echoes in every face I meet⤵️

Lilith refused to kneel. Hecate lit the path. Sekhmet turned rage into fire.

Kali destroyed to create. The Morrigan crowned warriors in blood. Artemis ran free.

Freyja took love and war in equal measure. Aphrodite didn’t just inspire desire—she commanded it.

Venus never settled. Medusa never forgave. Persephone walked into the underworld and made it her throne.

You cannot invoke goddesses like these and stay small. You were meant to be untamed.
